data.subheadline: Senior Backend & Cloud Engineer. Design-then-implement, deterministic rules. From Madagascar roots to global-scale systems used by millions.

journey.title: My journey
paragraphs: I'm a Senior Backend & Cloud Engineer based near Paris, with 8+ years building production systems used by millions.

Design first, then implement: I write the spec, favor simple deterministic rules, and build from there. I started out in Madagascar, where reliability wasn't optional and fast learning was a necessity. That foundation still defines how I work; and when I commit to a project, I treat it as my own.
I now build and modernize infrastructure and high-traffic APIs in international teams.
